capabilities: Mirror Claude Code sessions into the vault as Markdown notes
Render tool calls and Claude's thinking as collapsed callouts
Sync automatically on launch, on a set interval, or on demand
Filter out subagent (sidechain) transcripts, system noise, and empty sessions
Configure the source path, target folder, and which callouts are included
disambiguation: Not a cross-device sync tool; it one-way mirrors local Claude Code session files into the vault, and synced notes are read-only.
extras: Desktop-only (needs Node's filesystem APIs), so it will not run on Obsidian mobile. Not yet in the community plugin directory; install via BRAT or manually from release files. No network requests or accounts; nothing leaves the machine.
problem: Claude Code stores session transcripts as JSONL files on disk that are not readable, searchable, or linkable from within Obsidian.

relations.evidence: mirrors every Claude Code session on your machine into your vault as Markdown notes

summary: Mirrors local Claude Code CLI session transcripts into the vault as read-only Markdown notes, one per session, regenerated on each sync.
